description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.



 About the Role 

 Veeam's Finance Transformation Office (FTO) is looking for a Finance AI Engineer to take AI in Finance from intent to production.

 In this hands-on role, you'll lead the technical design and delivery of AI solutions across Controllership, FP&A, Revenue, Tax, and Treasury. You'll tackle opportunities ranging from agentic workflows and intelligent automation to anomaly detection, forecasting, and natural language interfaces for financial data.

 You'll partner closely with Finance and Corporate Technology to identify high-value use cases, determine the right approach, build and deploy AI agents and automations, and help Finance teams confidently adopt and own the solutions you create.

 We're looking for someone who understands how Finance works, has delivered AI-enabled solutions that improved real business processes, and knows how to build AI systems that are reliable, measurable, secure, and trusted enough for Finance leadership to use in critical workflows.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Lead Finance AI use case design. Identify and design AI solutions across Controllership, FP&A, Revenue, Tax, and Treasury, including agentic workflows, intelligent automation, anomaly detection, forecasting, and natural language interfaces to financial data.

 Choose the right AI approach. Determine whether a problem is best solved through Assist, Automate, or Agentic patterns, including recognizing when an AI agent isn't the right solution.

 Partner with Finance teams. Work directly with analysts, accountants, and process owners to understand workflows, identify manual effort and pain points, and translate business, data, and control requirements into actionable solutions.

 Build and deploy AI agents end to end. Take solutions from rapid prototype through validation, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handoff.

 Build evaluation and verification frameworks. Develop golden test sets, LLM-as-judge and human review scoring, grounding and verification techniques, and regression gates to continuously measure quality and catch drift.

 Connect Finance data and systems. Write and optimize SQL against enterprise Finance data platforms and integrate with ERP, planning, CRM, close, and reporting systems through APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors.

 Operationalize AI solutions. Build production-ready systems with version control, CI/CD, scheduling, retries, logging, alerting, rollback capabilities, and token/cost tracking.

 Drive AI fluency across Finance. Lead hands-on sessions and create playbooks, SOPs, and runbooks that enable Finance power users to confidently manage prompts, skills, and configurations.

 Partner with Corporate Technology. Align on model access, entitlements, connectors, deployment paths, and technical ownership while proactively solving platform constraints.

 Measure adoption and business impact. Track outcomes such as hours returned, cycle-time improvements, accuracy, adoption, and the percentage of processes supported by AI through FTO governance.

 Enable long-term ownership. Document solutions, train Finance teams, and transition day-to-day ownership so deployed solutions can continue to evolve.

 
 What You'll Bring 

 
 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering, automation, solutions delivery, or a related technical field, including hands-on delivery of AI-enabled tools, agents, or automations that changed a real business process.

 Working knowledge of Finance processes such as close, consolidation, forecasting, variance analysis, revenue, ARR, and billings, along with an understanding of how data flows through accounting, reporting, and planning systems.

 Strong production Python skills, including typed, tested, and packaged code, plus experience with Git, code review, CI/CD, secrets management, and dependency management.

 Hands-on experience with LLMs and agent engineering, including structured outputs, tool/function calling, multi-step or multi-agent orchestration, context management, and integration frameworks such as MCP.

 Experience building AI evaluation and verification frameworks, including golden datasets, scoring, regression testing, grounding, and output verification.

 Advanced SQL skills, including CTEs, window functions, and complex joins.

 Experience working with modern enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, including jobs/workflows and data-quality checks.

 Experience integrating REST APIs and OAuth, including pagination, rate limits, and idempotency.

 Understanding of production observability principles, including structured logging, tracing, alerting, and AI workload cost tracking.

 Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for Finance users and senior leaders.

 Experience enabling users through training, documentation, coaching, or ownership handoffs.

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 
 Technologies 

 You'll work across technologies and concepts including:

 
 Python

 SQL

 Databricks

 Large Language Models (LLMs)

 AI agents and multi-agent orchestration

 Model Context Protocol (MCP)

 REST APIs and OAuth

 Git and version control

 CI/CD

 AI evaluation and regression frameworks

 Prompt Engineering

 Structured logging, tracing, and monitoring

 ERP, financial planning, CRM, close, and reporting platforms

 Enterprise Finance data platforms

 
 Bonus Skills 

 It's a plus if you bring:

 
 Experience working at a high-growth SaaS or cloud software company

 Hands-on experience with Databricks Genie and AI/BI tools

 Experience building with Claude or ChatGPT, including APIs, agents, MCP, or custom GPTs

 Working knowledge of NetSuite and Pigment, including their data structures and APIs

 Experience building CI/CD pipelines for Finance data workloads in Databricks

 Experience working in a SOX-controlled environment

 A CPA, CFA, or formal Finance/Accounting background

 
 #LI-TI1
 What you'll get 

 
 Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares 

 Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents 

 Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day 

 Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program 

 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions 

 Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time 

 AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost 

 Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options 

 Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting 

 Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning 

 
 Compensation Transparency 

 Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range. 

 In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off. 

 U.S. Geographic Zones & Compensation Ranges (TTC / OTE) 

 Zone 1: San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Boroughs
 $146,760 — $272,520 USD 

 Zone 2: Washington, California (excluding San Francisco Bay Area)
 $134,530 — $249,810 USD 

 Zone 3: Texas, Illinois, North Carolina, Colorado, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Oregon, Nevada, Hawaii, New York (excluding NYC boroughs); Sales roles located in Georgia, Ohio, and Arizona
 $122,300 — $227,100 USD 

 Zone 4: All other US locations
 $106,401 — $197,577 USD 


 
 Veeam Software is an equal opportunity employer and does not tolerate discrimination in any form on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. All your information will be kept confidential.

 Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Notice , which explains how your information is collected, used, and handled in connection with hiring activities. By applying for this position, you consent to this processing. 

 By submitting your application, you confirm that the information provided, including any supporting documents, is complete and accurate to the best of your knowledge. Any misrepresentation, omission, or falsification may result in disqualification from consideration or, if discovered after employment begins, termination of employment.
